usedFor: Paystack holds payments and subscriptions, and Google Calendar books a follow-up with “Create Calendar Event” after “Cancelled Subscription”.

bestTemplate.name: “Cancelled Subscription” in Paystack, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation deserves a conversation, and the action sets time, duration, attendees and meeting details.

watchOut: “Cancelled Subscription” is polling and looks only at recent cancellations, so a short delay is normal.
